instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes fields unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after end-to-end evidence exists.

features.description: The current product contract is documented with real repo paths, design-system facts, validation commands, and phase boundaries.
steps: Open docs/misaya_notes_product_upgrade_2026_06_19/phase-00-current-product-contract-and-evidence-audit.md.
Inspect the current repo, prior harnesses, local design system, and parallel review findings.
Write docs/misaya_notes_product_upgrade_2026_06_19/reports/mnp-00-current-product-contract-and-evidence-audit-report.md with validation evidence.
features.notes: MNP-00 unlocks downstream work as a planning baseline only; it does not mark UI/product implementation phases complete.

features.description: Public UI and owner tools no longer read as AI-template glass/space dashboards; dark and light modes remain readable and distinct.
steps: Open docs/misaya_notes_product_upgrade_2026_06_19/phase-01-ui-anti-slop-visual-system.md.
Reduce gratuitous glow, glass, grid, chip density, and control-console composition.
Capture desktop/mobile screenshots for public dark/light and owner dark-lock routes.

features.description: Article detail pages expose readable content early and render mixed Markdown, KaTeX, code, images, and tables without layout breakage.
steps: Open docs/misaya_notes_product_upgrade_2026_06_19/phase-02-reading-experience-and-format-rendering.md.
Add or refresh fixture coverage for rich article formatting and CJK/English reading time.
Verify article entry, guide, Agent prompt, and body order across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

features.description: Blog Agent answers preserve grounded-source trust through stable anchors, clear failure recovery, quota/context feedback, and useful admin evals.
steps: Open docs/misaya_notes_product_upgrade_2026_06_19/phase-03-blog-agent-product-reliability.md.
Verify source-card anchors, no-source fallback, partial stream failure, cancel, timeout, low quota, and uploaded context limits.
Write unit/browser evidence without exposing hidden or draft content.

features.description: Summaries, UI labels, introductions, and conclusions sound concrete and technical rather than generic or author-subjective.
steps: Open docs/misaya_notes_product_upgrade_2026_06_19/phase-04-article-voice-and-quality-system.md.
Rewrite high-signal metadata and UI copy before touching technical claims.
Run content audit and reader screenshots; avoid changing slugs, formulas, code, dates, or hidden status without fresh evidence.

features.description: High-risk UI and Agent code is simplified through scoped extraction, token consolidation, and tests instead of broad rewrites.
steps: Open docs/misaya_notes_product_upgrade_2026_06_19/phase-05-code-simplification-and-css-architecture.md.
Remove contradictory CSS override conflicts and consolidate theme tokens where behavior is proven.
Extract pure logic from PostDetail/Search/Agent only with focused tests and behavior parity evidence.

features.description: A selected implementation slice is checked, committed, pushed, deployed, smoke-tested in production, and documented with rollback notes.
steps: Open docs/misaya_notes_product_upgrade_2026_06_19/phase-06-release-evidence-and-production-verification.md.
Run full checks and browser/production smoke appropriate to the changed slice.
Write docs/misaya_notes_product_upgrade_2026_06_19/reports/mnp-06-release-evidence-and-production-verification-report.md with deployment evidence.
